question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
WITH season_constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) as total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
    HAVING SUM(cs.points) > 0
),
min_points_per_season AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MIN(total_points) as min_points
    FROM season_constructor_points
    GROUP BY year
),
lowest_scorers AS (
    SELECT 
        scp.year,
        scp.constructor_id
    FROM season_constructor_points scp
    JOIN min_points_per_season mps ON scp.year = mps.year AND scp.total_points = mps.min_points
),
constructor_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        constructor_id,
        COUNT(*) as times_lowest
    FROM lowest_scorers
    GROUP BY constructor_id
    ORDER BY times_lowest DESC, constructor_id
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT c.name as CONSTRUCTOR_NAME
FROM constructor_counts cc
JOIN constructors c ON cc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
ORDER BY cc.times_lowest DESC, cc.constructor_id
